findings.title: Stale-save half of #611 unpinned — pin test proves typed→dict→render but never drives Save (guard: save persists the NEW value must be pinned by a test that bites)
findings.detail: Pin asserts dict write + re-render only. Existing save tests (6593, 6646) assert inflight/saving flags, not payload values. save_refcheck_edit builds the payload from the same dict entry (client.gleam 6816-6829), so the chain is transitively safe, but a save-path re-key regression would silently stale-save with no test failing — the exact #611 harm class.
findings.recommended_fix: Extend the pin: after simulate.input, dispatch the trio save (simulate.click on refcheck-edit-save-landlord_ref or simulate.message UserSavedRefcheckEdit("rc-1")); assert saving=True and the entry retains the TYPED values.
findings.evidence: client/test/client_test.gleam:6792-6801 (new pin): "let edited = simulate.model(sim).refcheck_edit |> dict.get(\"rc-1\") ... edit.email |> should.equal(\"maeve.fixed@example.ie\")" — no save dispatch follows. client.gleam:6816-6829: "reference_checks_api.correct_reference(vid, aid, call, name, email, phone, csrf, on_response)".

findings.title: Substitute trio + refetch/reorder survival unexercised — pin drives only RefcheckEditCorrect on one static row (acceptance #2, guard's reorder/refetch clause)
findings.detail: Fixture is one AwaitingCorrection call, kind RefcheckEditCorrect, no refetch. The shared view_edit_trio makes the substitute arm structurally covered, and the PR evidences live substitute verification, but no automated test would fail on a substitute-only or refetch regression.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a sibling simulate test: Objected call with can_substitute_referee=True seeded RefcheckEditSubstitute (empty prefill), type into the trio, assert dict write under reference_call_id; optionally dispatch the refetch with a reordered list and assert the typed edit survives.
findings.evidence: client_test.gleam:6743 "..refcheck_call(\"rc-1\", reference_call.AwaitingCorrection)," and 6763 "kind: model.RefcheckEditCorrect," — no substitute fixture; no refetch dispatch in the pin body.

findings.title: Name/phone branches of UserEditedRefcheckTrio untested — the `_ -> edit` fallback would silently swallow a wrong field string (the #611 swallow class)
findings.detail: The diff changed the name and phone dispatch-key lines (reference_panel.gleam:1110,1124), but only the email path is typed in any test. A mistyped field literal would fall into `_ -> edit` and drop keystrokes with no failure.
findings.recommended_fix: In the extended pin, also simulate.input into refcheck-edit-name-landlord_ref and refcheck-edit-phone-landlord_ref and assert both dict writes.

findings.title: Re-render assertion string-matches serialized HTML
findings.detail: Substring match on element.to_string couples the test to Lustre attribute serialization; breaks on rendering-internal changes rather than regressions.
findings.recommended_fix: Use lustre/dev/query to read the element's value attribute instead.

findings.title: Formal /bug-hunt scenario re-run (issue AC 3) not evidenced in the PR
findings.detail: The issue's acceptance requires /bug-hunt reference_checks panel-correct and panel-substitute to pass. The PR evidences a live-browser repro (typing holds, DB persists, substitute creates the row) but the scenario re-run is not claimed.
findings.recommended_fix: Re-run both scenarios with the bug-hunt skill and cite the result, or note explicitly in the PR why the live repro supersedes it. (The reference_checks scenario dir is not present at this sha.)
findings.evidence: ls .pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/ at sha → analytics, applications, auth, billing, comparison, dashboard, errors, landing, notifications, settings, ui, vacancies, workflows — no reference_checks.

findings.title: Briefing's 'fail loud' runtime requirement not implemented — deviation documented and justified in the PR body
findings.detail: Briefing fix requirement #4 demanded loud runtime failure; the diff touches only the view and the test. The PR's instrumentation falsified the runtime-swallow premise (events dispatch; bug was a dict-key mismatch), so the deviation is evidence-backed. Accepted as documented deviation; the pin test is the durable guard.
findings.recommended_fix: None required — deviation accepted on the PR's evidence. Keep the root-cause writeup in the PR body.
findings.evidence: diff.patch file list: reference_panel.gleam +3/-3, client_test.gleam +78. PR body: "Since the runtime isn't at fault, the durable guarantee is the pin test."

findings.title: Testids remain slot-keyed (guard-required unchanged) — same-slot testid collision is a documented pre-existing deferral
findings.detail: Guard requires a11y/testids unchanged (bug-hunt selectors depend on them). With two rows sharing a ref_slot, testids collide — test-selection exposure only; the dict side is now per-call correct. Predates this fix; PR body documents the deferral.
findings.recommended_fix: None for this PR — revisit testid keying only with coordinated bug-hunt scenario updates.
findings.evidence: reference_panel.gleam:1110-1124: testid lines unchanged — "refcheck-edit-name-" <> slot etc.
